utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. If you can bring any tools and spare screws you have, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll grab my tools and see what spare screws I can find.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Oren. That’ll help a lot—I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — just let me know what’s still missing, and I’ll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Leo — I’ll keep the list updated and let you know what’s still missing. We’re at the community center on Sunday now, so just bring anything you’ve got then.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll bring what I can on Sunday. Just send the updated list when you can.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out and pass along any houses that need help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — that’d be really helpful. I’ll check with the group and keep it lined up with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—just let me know if anything urgent comes up. I’ll keep an ear out for any houses needing help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Cleo — I can bring my toolbox and lend a hand if you need help sorting out tools or parts.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — that’d be a big help. I’m finishing the list now, and I’ll let you know which tools or parts we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to help, Cleo — just let me know what’s missing and I’ll bring my toolbox over.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still waiting on the broken items and names. Once we’ve got that list, we can get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Eli — once you have the broken items and names, send them my way and I’ll help get the list moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Mara. I’ll send the broken items and names your way as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s happening for real—go ahead and tell people the repair drive is on!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks, Tess. I’ll let folks know, and if anyone’s bringing donations, please send them in small batches so I can keep track of pickups.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — small batches make sense, I’ll pass that along. Thanks for keeping track of everything!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive, and I’ll send you over to the fence fix.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still headed to the community center to check the exact room for the repair drive. I’ll let you know as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. Just let me know the room when you find it, and I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive—I’ve been a bit out of the loop. I should check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries—just let me know when you’ve checked. We’re still planning for Saturday morning, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Hana — Saturday morning might work, but I should double-check the details first and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out a bit—what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m in and I’ll be there for the repair drive. What would you like me to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — we still need a clear list of what’s broken and who’s taking each job. If you can help sort that out first, we can get the drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive. If you hear anyone who can bring tools or lend a hand, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still a bit behind, but I can jump in where it matters most. Is the fence fix still the biggest thing left?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, the fence fix is still the biggest thing left. If you can help with that, I’ll keep rounding up anyone who can bring tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I’m in — I’ll stop by the repair drive and see what I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and point folks your way with any tools, spare parts, or time to help. Thanks, Ira!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks Jules — I’ll be there and lend a hand where I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yep, it’s really happening. I’ll ask around and see which repairs folks say are most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — thanks, Nell. Let me know what you hear, and I can help with the top priority repairs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll ask around and bring you the most urgent ones as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That fence fix does still sound like the biggest thing left. If you tell me what’s needed, I can help get everyone pointed the right way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking one more time — you’re really coming to the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’m coming to the repair drive. Tell me what still needs doing, and I’ll help get people pointed the right way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the pickups if that would take some pressure off. What’s the best thing for me to grab first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — could you start with the spare parts first? If you can also keep a running list of what’s already picked up, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can do that. I’ll start with the spare parts and keep a running list of what’s been picked up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m in for the repair drive. What would you like me to take on first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Sam — bring the toolbox and we’ll tackle what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do — I’ll bring the toolbox and be there to help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up too—has anyone put together the broken-things list yet?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m on it now—I’ve checked what we’ve got and I’m putting together what’s still missing for the repair drive. I’ll bring you the list as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps—just let me know once the list’s ready and I’ll catch up from there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m still spreading the word, and I can point folks to the fence fix too. Just send me any updates and I’ll keep neighbors in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Quinn — I’ll send you anything I hear. What should I help with first on the fence fix?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Could you start by checking the loose boards and seeing if we need any extra nails or tools? I’ll keep neighbors updated while you do.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still headed to the community center to check the exact room for the repair drive. I’ll let you know as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — let me know the room when you find it, and I’ll keep an eye on the school schedule on my end.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’m heading over there now and I’ll message you the room as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah, sorry I’m late—what’s still left to do on the repair drive? I can help with the fence if you still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, I’ve been a bit out of the loop. I should check what’s still needed and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries — just let me know when you’ve checked, and I can jump in on the fence if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’m still keeping things low-key, but I’ll help where I can with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Uli — that helps a lot. I’ll keep it low-key too and let you know if anything comes up with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I appreciate that—just keep me posted, and I’ll help out quietly where I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Ira — if you’re heading to the repair drive, I can bring my toolbox over and help sort out what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Gus — I’m in for the repair drive and I’ll keep an ear out for any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — thanks, Ira. Just give me a shout when you know the time, and I’ll swing by with the toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll head to the fence and bring gloves if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps a lot, thanks Leo — the fence is right by the east path, and I’ll meet you there now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: On my way now — I’ll meet you at the east path.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We still need a clear list of what’s broken and who’s taking each job. Once that’s set, we can get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Right, that makes sense — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along that we still need the broken-item list and job assignments.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Tess. Once you’ve got that list, send it my way and we can get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—it's now Sunday at the community center, and I’m coming. I’ll keep the list updated if anything else changes.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks Rosa. Keep me posted if the room or timing changes, and I’ll bring the urgent list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Will do, Mina — I’ll let you know right away if the room or timing shifts. Thanks for bringing the urgent list.
